theorems.name: Submission.p02_es_177ebb5a_pp_scaled_cusp_decay
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (n : ℕ) (f : CuspForm (CongruenceSubgroup.Gamma0 N) ((n : ℤ) + 2)) (σ : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ), ∃ (a C Y : ℝ), 0 < a ∧ 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ τ : UpperHalfPlane, Y ≤ τ.im → ‖(HeckeEis.jFactor σ τ) ^ (-((n : ℤ) + 2)) * f (σ • τ)‖ ≤ C * Real.exp (-a * τ.im)
theorems.natural_summary: Translate f by σ to a cusp form on the conjugate arithmetic subgroup. Apply the pinned Mathlib exponential-decay theorem, then extract a nonnegative constant and a uniform height threshold from its big-O bound. The SL₂ slash formula and jFactor_eq_denom identify the translated function with the required expression; positivity of the real exponential removes its norm.
